reviewer_role: Independent reviewer; no plotting implementation or author code read
isolation: Instruction-isolated review, not an operating-system sandbox guarantee

visual_assessment.evidence: Opened the supplied reference and current candidate PNG. Eight horizontal purple violins have the required top-to-bottom cohort order, complete labels, a linear BMI axis with kg/m² units and 20/40/60 labels, faint guides beneath marks, and no unrequested points, central statistics, or legend. No clipping, missing glyphs, label collisions, or row collisions were found.

findings.evidence: The visible lobes and flat extrema differ modestly from the reference; the adopted specification explicitly uses Gaussian KDE, Scott bandwidths, observed-range trimming, and equal displayed-area normalization. Saved curves and exported SVG polygons agree with those decisions.
findings.requirement: Preserve supplied observations and disclose unknown original density settings rather than fit data or parameters to pixels.
findings.action: No figure correction required. Retain the adopted-method and unknown-author-parameter notes.

findings.evidence: The BMI display is wider than its column in the multi-panel reference. Full cohort labels remain readable with substantial row separation on the requested 132 × 99 mm canvas.
findings.requirement: Deliver one standalone panel at the requested dimensions with all text at 8 pt.
findings.action: Accepted adaptation; no resizing or extra rendering requested.

findings.evidence: Readability was judged from the actual PNG together with measured export dimensions and 8 pt type. Screen magnification is not a physical print proof.
findings.requirement: Distinguish inspected appearance and measured typography from unperformed print testing.
findings.action: No required correction. A physical print proof was not part of this review.

source_record_and_value_preservation.evidence: A separate numerical sub-review compared CSVs: all 864 rows retain the four source columns, original BMI strings, and record order. All 858 available values are included; the six blanks remain missing. Cohort labels, counts, and source hash agree.

density_calculation.evidence: The numerical sub-review independently evaluated Gaussian mixtures from the supplied values. Eight cohorts each have 512 evenly spaced samples on their observed range; bandwidth/statistic differences are below 9e-16 and raw-density differences below 1.3e-16. Each displayed curve integrates to one; the common multiplier yields maximum full thickness 0.9 rows.

rendered_svg_uses_saved_density.evidence: Reviewer independently parsed eight purple SVG polygons and compared them with every saved density sample using the adopted BMI transform and measured row spacing. Maximum x error was 4.9995e-7 pt and maximum y error was 7.7414e-7 pt, consistent with SVG decimal rounding.

pdf_dimensions_typography_and_bounds.evidence: Direct PDF inspection found one page measuring 131.999996 × 98.999997 mm; all 12 text spans are 8 pt and inside the page. ArialMT is embedded with 26148 font bytes.

svg_dimensions_and_type.evidence: Direct SVG inspection found width 374.173228 pt, height 280.629921 pt and matching viewBox, equivalent to 132 × 99 mm. All 12 editable text elements specify Arial and size 8 in the point-scaled coordinate system.

png_dimensions_and_resolution.evidence: Direct PNG inspection found 1559 × 1169 pixels with 299.9994 dpi metadata in both directions, the rounded 300 dpi export at the requested dimensions.

original_publication_data_authentication.evidence: The supplied source CSV was the review input; the original workbook/article and author code were not accessed.

unresolved_items: Original KDE estimator, bandwidth, support, normalization, and exact colors remain unknown, as already disclosed.
next_action: Keep this candidate; retain its documented adaptations and statistical limits.
